## Hypothesis

The overnight_grinder identified a parameter combination that significantly increases wide_pnl by exploiting favorable quarters in 2025-Q4 through 2026-Q2, but fails to capture J's mandated winner trades on 4/29 and 5/01. ## Mechanism

These changes likely increase position sizing and profit targets during favorable regimes while tightening risk controls on super setups.
